source_label: Jensen, Kelly & Pedersen — Is There a Replication Crisis in Finance?
formula: CHMOM = ret_6_1 − ret_12_7；JKP 分别列示 ret_6_1 与 ret_12_7，但不构造二者之差。
data_fields: CRSP: monthly RET
calculation_window_zh: ret_6_1 使用 t−6 至 t−1；ret_12_7 使用 t−12 至 t−7。
calculation_window_en: ret_6_1 uses t−6 to t−1; ret_12_7 uses t−12 to t−7.
accounting_lag_en: Not applicable; return data only.
portfolio_rule_zh: JKP 对每个组成特征按国家—月份形成三分位，以非微型股确定断点，采用设上限的市值加权并持有一个月；这些规则并未用于 CHMOM 差值。
portfolio_rule_en: For each component characteristic, JKP forms country-month terciles using non-microcap breakpoints, capped value weights, and one-month holding; these rules are not applied to a CHMOM difference factor.
notes_zh: JKP 将两个窗口视为独立的正向动量特征（两者原文符号均为 +1）。因此它可验证 CHMOM 的代数拆分，却不能验证 CHMOM 本身的收益方向或组合设计。
notes_en: JKP treats both windows as separate positive-signed momentum characteristics. It verifies the algebraic decomposition but not CHMOM’s own return direction or portfolio design.

source_label: Novy-Marx — Is Momentum Really Momentum? (Journal of Financial Economics)
data_fields: CRSP: monthly RET
calculation_window_zh: 组合形成前第 12 至第 7 个月的累计收益。
calculation_window_en: Cumulative return over months t−12 to t−7 before portfolio formation.
accounting_lag_en: Not applicable; return data only.
portfolio_rule_zh: 按较早期中期动量排序；高 ret_12_7 相对低 ret_12_7。
portfolio_rule_en: Sort on intermediate-horizon past performance; high ret_12_7 relative to low ret_12_7.
notes_zh: 这是最接近的顶级金融期刊构造，但仅对应 CHMOM 的第二个组成部分，而且 CHMOM 对该部分取负号；它不是 CHMOM 的原始出处。
notes_en: This is the closest top-finance-journal construction, but it is only CHMOM’s second component and CHMOM enters it with a negative sign; it is not the source of CHMOM.

source_label: Ardila-Alvarez, Forró & Sornette — The acceleration effect and Gamma factor in asset pricing
formula: Γ_i,t(f) = r_i,t(f) − r_i,t−f(f); f = 6 gives a difference between adjacent six-month returns.
data_fields: Monthly stock prices or returns
calculation_window_zh: 一般 Γ 在两个相邻的等长窗口间取收益差；f=6 时与 CHMOM 的窗口逻辑相同。论文基准 Γ* 另向前平移六个月。
calculation_window_en: General Γ differences two adjacent equal-length return windows; at f=6 its window logic matches CHMOM. The paper’s baseline Γ* is shifted back by an additional six months.
accounting_lag_en: Not applicable; return data only.
portfolio_rule_zh: 按 Γ* 形成市值加权十分位组合；做多高 Γ*、做空低 Γ*。
portfolio_rule_en: Value-weighted decile portfolios sorted on Γ*; long high Γ* and short low Γ*.
notes_zh: 这是后续正式发表的加速度构造，但发表在 Physica A，并非顶级金融期刊；其基准 Γ* 与 CHMOM 还存在额外六个月位移。
notes_en: This is a later published acceleration construction in Physica A, not a top finance journal; its baseline Γ* also differs from CHMOM by an additional six-month shift.
